title: Playing fetch with Diesel on the beach
text: Ja, so today. Spent most of today playing fetch with Diesel on the beach, fixing a car and running my market stall. Drew up plans for something new: 🛺 Tuk-tuk Garage, a garage just for fixing tuk-tuks. Learned a bit about Tourism in Thailand. Wet day. Good for the garage, bad for everything else. Beach time: playing fetch with Diesel on the beach (Diesel's tail goes mad). Diesel and me, best team in town. Made 12 coins. Collected 5 bricks. Also: The cafe has a new coffee on the board. Still dreaming of Thailand. 458 coins between me and that road. Tired but fine.

title: Finished building the Market stall
text: Quick one tonight. Spent most of today building, cooking a proper meal and chatting with the locals. Finished building the Market stall! Stood back and had a proper look at it. Lekker. Drew up plans for something new: 🌻 Rooftop Garden, a garden on a roof full of sunflowers. Did some reading on Tourism in Thailand. Interesting stuff. Wet day. Good for the garage, bad for everything else. Beach time: collecting shells (+3 shells (3 in the jar)). Diesel was a bit restless. Must give him more time tomorrow. Pretty sure Diesel was planning to teach the seagulls some manners. Cheeky. Coins didn't move. Collected 8 bricks, used 20 on building. Also: A kid drops a bolt and asks I what it's for. Thailand feels closer today. 470 to go. Tomorrow again.
tomorrow: Collect bricks and start something new.

title: Training Diesel
text: Eish, where do I start. Spent most of today training Diesel, fixing a car and collecting bricks. Drew up plans for something new: 🌅 Sunset Pier, a little wooden pier over a blue plastic pond. Worked on tricks with Diesel a few times. Diesel was a bit restless. Must give him more time tomorrow. Made 10 coins. Collected 8 bricks. Also: A scruffy little brick puppy followed Jarvis home and won't leave. He needs a name. 30 coins saved. Every one of them is a kilometre of Thai road. Tired but fine.
tomorrow: Fix a few cars, fill the jar.
